profile.headline: I fix typos and write SEO-driven copy for social media and blogs | Prooofreader | Copyeditor | Content Writer & Copywriter | Transcriptionist & Polyglot in-the-making | Prev. web designer and developer
profile.summary:
Hello. I go by Angie, and I'm a newly trained proofreader with ambitions to also become a copyeditor, content writer and copywriter. I enjoy the literary things in life: reading novels, learning and speaking foreign languages, and figuring out my writing voice to name a few. 

As a freelancer, my hope is to develop long and trusting relations with my clients. 

I quit web design and development in 2026 after realizing it wasn't for me, and now I'm returning to my happy place: my literary and language roots. I adore being among books and language and words. As a heritage Spanish-speaker with Mexican roots, and a fan of old English literature, I also possess degrees in both English and Spanish. I hope to learn transcription starting in 2027 and use my language background to become a professional translator as well.

projects.title: Gold Leaf Settlement Solutions
projects.description:
Creating a web application for Gold Leaf Settlement Solutions, a Florida-based settlement and annuities company.

Collaborated with UX designer to design and develop a custom application within a 6-month timeframe.
Tools/Technologies used: Figma, Ant Design UI Kit, React, Redux, Framer Motion

• Addressed client’s desires for a mobile-friendly web application by architecting the front-end with a mobile-first approach.
• Utilized the Framer Motion library for smooth animations and page transitions.
• Ensured a seamless user experience that contained cross-device functionality, including capabilities to transition to portrait and landscape views, thus exceeding client’s expectations during the 4 month development.
